# Renovating from abroad: how we manage the construction site for those living overseas

Living at a distance makes it particularly important to know what decisions to make, whom to contact, and what information to receive. Marenetto Build operates via SAL (Stato di Avanzamento Lavori / Work Progress Reports), with phases defined in the bill of quantities (computo metrico) by the designer and a single point of contact from the firm. The relationship between the client, the firm, and professionals remains distinct and must be clarified in the engagement.

## Summary

- Preparing the first consultation
- Point of contact, languages, and responsibilities
- SAL, photos, reports, and WhatsApp updates
- Variations, documents, and handover
- Continuity with property management
- Frequently asked questions

## What to prepare before starting the project

Communicate where the property is located, how it is used, and what changes you desire. Available photographs and floor plans can help set the stage for discussion, but they do not replace on-site inspections, surveys, or document verification. Before sending complete files containing personal data, agree on which documents are necessary and how to transmit them.

The project must distinguish between works, any supplies, and professional appointments. Design, site management (direzione lavori), and safety (sicurezza) do not automatically become the contractor's responsibility simply because the owner lives abroad.

## A clear point of contact and languages actually confirmed

The owner confirms that the team and the Cefalù Apartments partner speak Italian, English, French, Dutch, and Spanish. This does not mean that every person speaks all these languages or is available at any time. The language of the point of contact and the organization of communication must be agreed upon before the appointment. Website translations do not equate to a twelve-language technical service.

The company provides a single point of contact. Language and communication methods are agreed upon with this contact, without promising continuous availability or attributing all languages of the team to one individual.

The operational contact person does not automatically replace the professional who signs a project or a verification. Ask to know who is responsible for each decision and who must be involved when work changes.

## SAL, photos, and report from the works director

The designer prepares the bill of quantities divided into phases. Upon reaching each phase, progress is documented with photos and a report from the surveyor or architect appointed as the works director (direttore dei lavori). The SAL describes the progress of the work: this guide does not establish payment deadlines or financial conditions, which depend on the agreements.

Between SALs, updates occur via WhatsApp with photos, videos, and recordings. A fixed frequency is not provided, and immediate response is not promised. The documentation helps discuss progress and decisions but does not replace site visits and checks by the professional.

We do not declare a customer portal for the construction site, dedicated personnel, or service levels that have not been confirmed. The partner's organization for rental management is not automatically attributed to the construction site.

## Approving variations without ambiguity

Before work begins, clarify who can authorize modifications and how to keep a record of them. For a variation, ask for a description, economic consequences, and calendar impact before approving it. An informal message should not leave it uncertain whether you have asked for clarification or authorized additional work.

Variations and urgencies are agreed upon with the client and the works director, updating the bill of quantities. When a change affects costs, supplies, or the schedule, these aspects must be clarified before approval, without promising that every urgency can be resolved remotely.

Delegations, property access, key custody, and procedures to follow if the client is unreachable require explicit agreements. General power to authorize additional work is not assigned to the point of contact.

## From delivery to managing the house

Agree on final documents, material instructions, relevant verifications, and any points to be completed. Whoever will use the house must be able to distinguish between routine maintenance, reports to be made to the contractor, and activities entrusted to other professionals.

At the end of the works, those who wish to can evaluate entrusting the property to Cefalù Apartments for third-party management: procedures, CIN, OTA, cleaning, and check-in, according to the agreed appointment. The service is distinct from the building contract and does not involve promises of occupancy or yield.

The page [Property management for third parties with Cefalù Apartments](https://www.marenettobuild.com/en/short-let-property-management-cefalu) describes the service and roles. The partner’s rental management software is not a site monitoring portal.

## How to start the discussion

Construction work is primarily followed within approximately 60 km of Cefalù, in the Madonie, and along the coast; projects further afield are evaluated upon request and dedicated quote. Consult the [construction services](/en/services) and write to [info@marenetto.com](mailto:info@marenetto.com), also indicating the desired language. The reference is a quote following an on-site inspection, not a definitive assessment based on images alone.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can I follow everything without ever coming to Sicily?

The organization and the potential necessity of your presence must be evaluated for the appointment. We do not promise entirely remote management or the absence of personal formalities.

### Will I receive photos every week?

We do not promise weekly submissions: each reached phase is documented for SAL with photos and a report from the works director; between phases, WhatsApp updates with photos, videos, and recordings are used, without a fixed frequency.

### Will I have assistance in German because the site is translated?

This cannot be deduced from the site. The languages confirmed for the team and partners are Italian, English, French, Dutch, and Spanish; the availability of the contact person in the requested language must be agreed upon.

## Sources and limitations

Languages, coverage, and the SAL process are declarations of the owner as of November 25, 2026, not external certifications. Consulted the same day: Municipality of Cefalù, SUE and Private Building Office for administrative aspects, and the public management page with Cefalù Apartments for the distinct service. The information guides the discussion; verifications, certifications, and reserved activities remain with the assigned qualified professionals.
